# EotG cyberware (head rig) customization lists, from items: comm_earpiece, crew_visor, dressing, face_mark, heatsink, lattice, optic, optic_seamless, panel, patch, rebreather, ring. Generated by ck3_cyberware.py regen; do not hand-edit.
# Race-specific variants (bull head, small/large/heavy frame, elf/orc/goblin/Chad Orc ears, tusks) are left out;
# RACE_VARIANT_TOKENS / RACE_GATES in scripts/ck3_cyberware.py list them again behind a race trigger.
